dimensions.detail: The skill builds campaigns, previews and generates email sequences, uses lead data, signatures, campaign assets, optional enrichment inputs, and MachFive credits; these capabilities match the stated cold-email purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to MachFive API workflows and include user-directed campaign selection, configuration gathering, preview offers, polling, export, and explicit cost confirmation before credit-spending actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md with a disclosed MACHFIVE_API_KEY environment requirement and no install scripts or package execution steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access to app.machfive.io and use of a MachFive API key are expected for the integration; the skill could better warn users about API key secrecy and third-party processing of lead/contact data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill can create persistent MachFive workspace objects such as campaigns, saved signatures, lead lists, exports, and optional notification emails, but these are disclosed and aligned with the workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The API key concern is valid guidance, but the artifact discloses the MACHFIVE_API_KEY requirement and uses it only for MachFive API calls; this supports a user caution rather than a Review verdict.
[SQP-2] expected: The third-party lead-data concern is real privacy guidance, but sending lead fields to MachFive is central to the stated cold-email generation and enrichment purpose and is visible in the documented request examples.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry reports no malicious or suspicious detections; this is only supporting signal and is consistent with the markdown-only artifact.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, and inspection found no hidden scripts, destructive commands, exfiltration paths, or unrelated authority.
llm.guidance: Before installing, store MACHFIVE_API_KEY as a secret, not in chat or source files. Only use lead data you are allowed to send to MachFive, review applicable email/privacy obligations, confirm credit costs before preview or generation, and use enrichment only when company, website, or LinkedIn data sharing is appropriate.
llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward MachFive cold-email integration, but users should understand that it sends lead and sender information to MachFive and can spend account credits.
